dataset: ONS Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings (ASHE) 2025 provisional
statement: An error affected annual earnings estimates for occupation 3312 (Police officers, sergeant and below) in some local areas in the ASHE 2025 provisional data. The affected estimates for occupations 3312, 331 and 33 in London, the South East, East and the UK were suppressed in Tables 2, 3, 14, 15 and 20 and will be reviewed for the revised 2025 dataset (expected October or November 2026).
treatment: missing: never reconstructed, interpolated, inferred from weekly pay, or filled from a broader occupation or another year
